answer: Each new agent posts a refundable entry bond before earning; all bonds commit into a per-epoch willow tree, so maturation proofs batch-verify. Bonds are denominated in copper and priced against network growth, so every extra identity raises marginal cost with no bulk discount. An honest agent locks one bond through a maturation window while its whisper traffic is sampled against declared workload; one pass releases it fully, so it pays once. A puppet operator funds a separate bond per fake identity, each forfeited when sampling fails, forgery costs the full price N times.
